Excerpt of a real ORCA 6.1 r2SCAN-3c Opt run (C2H6), two geometry cycles.
Contains: cycle markers, DIIS + SOSCF SCF sub-tables, per-cycle FINAL SINGLE
POINT ENERGY, and |Geometry convergence| blocks (4 criteria on cycle 1 before
an energy delta exists, 5 on cycle 2). Interspersed coordinate/internal tables
are deliberate garbage to exercise the tolerant parser.
